races.verdict: NEW BOND STREET showed the benefit of her first run when finishing third at Naas 18 days ago and, with her yard going well, she could be ready to get off the mark. Snowing is feared most with Aidan O'Brien having landed this race 4 times in the last 6 years, with Tradewinds and Jewel In A Crowd completing the shortlist. NEW BOND STREET SNOWING (IRE) TRADEWINDS (IRE)

races.verdict: IBELIEVEICANFLY proved a let down here last time but she was surrounded by next-time-out winners when second over C&D the time before so she's worth another chance with Ryan Moore keeping the faith. Her stablemate Speckles was a big eye-catcher in a C&D maiden 3 weeks ago so is respected, while Suomenlinna and Miss Hong Kong are a couple of interesting newcomers. races.display_title: Guidenstown Stud Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict: SHAKESPEARE is the mount of Ryan Moore from the Ballydoyle trio and can make it third time lucky in a race in which his stable has saddled a future Group 1 winner in each of the last 3 years. Anchor Road shaped well when third over C&D last time and may provide the chief threat. Loughrea N Roll and the selection's stablemate Raging Bull are just a couple of many newcomers in the line-up who are bred to have good futures. SHAKESPEARE ANCHOR ROAD (IRE) LOUGHREA N ROLL (IRE)

Speakasyoufind needs to bounce back from a below-par performance but remains of interest on his June runner-up effort, while the often well-backed Hay Baby is respected on just her second start for Emmet Mullins.
